A_gt_provenance.note: Swiss-Prot external ground truth used identically to main experiment. Same SWISSPROT_DAT file, same 1500 sequence test split from main-experiment m1 activations layer1.pt. Cache at runs/cache/swissprot/all_annotations.pkl reused. No synthetic or proxy GT introduced.

B_score_normalization.note: F1 scores range [0,1] by construction. Same normalization as main experiment. ratio_covered_sae_over_neuron computed as covered_sae/covered_neuron (with inf when denominator=0, consistent with main experiment).

C_result_existence.note: All four required output files present and non-empty: coverage.json (1.6KB), sensitivity.json (0.6KB), per_concept_best_F1.parquet, cost.json. Run log (271 lines) confirms all 6 layers completed.

D_dead_code.note: Variant script is self-contained. No dead code paths. All functions (collect_8m_hidden_states, f1_matrix_sparse, f1_matrix_dense, compute_neuron_topmask, build_concept_mask) are called in main(). No unused utility functions.

E_scope.note: Scope fully disclosed: 1500 sequences (same as main experiment), 387195 residues, 400 concepts (support>=25), 6 layers, 10240 SAE features per layer, 320 neuron dims. Run completed in 255 seconds. No overclaim.

F_eval_type.note: Real external GT (Swiss-Prot annotations) used throughout. Per-residue F1 alignment protocol identical to main experiment. Consistency judgment is direction-based (SAE > neurons), which is the scientifically meaningful axis for C2.
